tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists Pest Control Pack's tools, treatments with their visits, times and materials, proofing items, time of day factors, signs it reads, control methods it checks, contract premises, default rates and what it deliberately does not do. Needs no input.

tools.name: identify_pest
tools.description: Ranks the likely pests from the signs a customer describes (droppings, noises, bites, nests, smells, damage), with a confidence, the urgency, the health risk, the treatment to price and the questions that settle it. Flags bees and bats, which must not be treated. Signs: droppings_large_capsule, drop

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "pest_method_check" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before using a control method, returns a verdict (allowed, allowed_with_conditions, licence_needed or not_allowed) for that pest and nation, with the conditions…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
